summary: iter-432 Expo SDK 54 → 57 regression sweep (web preview only). Overall: upgrade is functional. Metro bundled cleanly (no 'Unable to resolve module', no SyntaxError, no TypeError in expo.out/err.log). Login (Gaurav.pandey/Student@123 and Abhijit.patil/Admin@123) works. Home dashboard renders (stats 41/6/3/0, Action Needed, Drafts). Icons: after migration to @react-native-vector-icons/ionicons + material-design-icons, computed fontFamily='Ionicons' appears on 46+ elements on Home and 201+ on My Cases; MaterialDesignIcons tooth glyph renders on /onboarding. Zero empty glyphs sampled. Bottom-tab navigation resolves URLs correctly (/procedures, /notifications, /new-procedure, /). My Cases list renders and tapping 'P2 Aug UI Patient' opens /procedures/{id} with Treatment Progress, Approval Status and Patient Information; export/print testID 'case-report-export-print-btn' present. New Case Phase 1 wizard Step 1 renders; Type of Implant Procedure dropdown opens under new react-native-screens 4.26 / expo-router 57 with all 16 options; selecting 'Implant Overdenture' reveals overdenture-type-dropdown which lists 'Implant Retained Overdenture' + 'Implant Supported Overdenture'; selecting 'All on 4' has no overdenture-type field (verified indirectly by conditional). Alerts (/notifications) renders scrollable feed. Onboarding renders (1/6 slide, Skip, Next). Advanced Analytics (/analytics/advanced) renders Kaplan-Meier survival curves (react-native-svg + reanimated) with all 12 tabs; Procedure Overview (/analytics/procedure-overview) renders 71 total cases / 62.5% success. Phase 2 form (/procedures/submit-phase2/{id} for phase1_approved) and Phase 4 Step 1 (/procedures/submit-stage2-prosthetic/{id} for stage2_surgical_approved) both render. No React Native red screens; no pageerrors. Only pre-existing/expected web warnings (shadow*, useNativeDriver, pointerEvents, tintColor, expo-notifications web token). ONE REAL REGRESSION SURFACED BY SDK 57: pre-existing 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' warnings are now escalated to LogBox 'Console Error' overlays (via new @expo/log-box@57.0.4 dep) which visually block interaction in dev mode. Origins: app/(tabs)/new-procedure.tsx:3488 (Schedule <View style={styles.section}>) and app/procedures/[id].tsx:832 (case-detail <ScrollView>). Production/release builds are unaffected because LogBox is dev-only, but every dev/preview session now shows a red overlay after visiting New Case or a case detail. Root cause is a stray whitespace/empty-string child JSX expression somewhere inside those subtrees (pre-existing bug, called out in iter_431 as pre-existing warnings). No package.json, app.json, metro.config.js, or .env changes were made.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The 'Unexpected text node' LogBox overlay under SDK 57 blocks tab-bar taps in dev mode once you land on New Case or a Case Detail. Workaround for automated tests: navigate directly to target URLs (page.goto('/procedures'), '/notifications', '/analytics/advanced', etc.) instead of tapping tabs, or dismiss the overlay first (Escape key does NOT close it — need to remove DOM nodes with id contains 'logbox' or press the small toast X). Prod builds are unaffected. Backend was NOT retested per request; iter-431 backend suite still green.
rca_of_issue: SDK 57 introduces @expo/log-box@57.0.4 which reclassifies the react-native-web 'Unexpected text node: X. A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' warning from console.warn to console.error and renders it as a blocking LogBox overlay. Two subtrees emit this warning: (a) new-procedure.tsx line 3488 (Schedule section View) and (b) procedures/[id].tsx line 832 (case-detail ScrollView). The stray child is likely an empty-string returned from a conditional expression (e.g. `{expr && ''}` or `{someMaybeString}`) or whitespace between a JSX comment and a sibling. Fix: audit each subtree's children and replace `''`/`false`/string literals with `null` or wrap in <Text>. Reproduction: open web preview, log in as Gaurav.pandey, tap 'New Case' tab (or navigate to /procedures/6a6b7fbf6633443cf356df15) — within ~1s a red LogBox overlay covers the screen showing 'Console Error: Unexpected text node' with a component stack rooted at NewProcedureScreen or ProcedureDetailScreen. Mitigation for CI: run against a production/release build where LogBox is disabled; permanent fix is the JSX audit above.
